title: Invoice Dispute Periods and Return Credits — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
**Billing desk guidance note — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms).**

The period within which a line on an invoice can be disputed depends on the account's terms tier and is counted in calendar days after the invoice date. On every tier, an amount under invoice dispute is excluded from late charges and holds, and returns of invoiced items are credited by a credit memo against the account.

| Terms tier | Dispute period (calendar days after the invoice date) | Disputed amount excluded from late charges and holds | Returns of invoiced items credited by credit memo against the account |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 45 | Yes | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 60 | Yes | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 60 | Yes | Yes |

**Tier contrasts.** The dispute period is 30 days on Net 15, Net 30 Standard and Net 30 Preferred, 45 days on Net 45 Volume, and 60 days on Net 60 Enterprise and Net 30 Public Sector. The other two columns read the same on every tier.
